# Issue #77 — independent proactive visual QA

[Record and durably accept a turn without losing protected media or navigation intent](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/77)

Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**. Review date: 2026-10-25. Scope: issue #77 only; review only. No product, specification, GitHub, index, commit or branch changes. Skills applied: Ponytail full, spec-task-review, design-taste-frontend app-screen guidance, and frontend-design; the owner-selected Affect UI Clean/Light and Mabry Pro take precedence over generic skill aesthetics.

## Verdict and provenance

**Needs targeted correction.** Two confirmed implementation defects and one requirement/design flaw: **0 HIGH / 3 MEDIUM / 0 LOW**. The basic native mock-backed capture, draft-review and first acceptance journey worked, but a candidate disables the required backward guard, and the 767px pinned layout covers the performance text. Desktop task controls also deserve a deliberate usability exception to the compact reference sizes.

Code baseline: `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. `git diff --name-only -- frontend` was empty before capture. Existing unrelated dirty/untracked docs/skills/evidence were preserved. The current local Flow09, tokens, adoption/catalog and issue snapshot were read; those local documents have their existing untracked provenance and are not claimed to be committed at baseline. Hashes are recorded in [snapshot.json](evidence/snapshot.json). The issue snapshot is dated 2026-10-25, closed, zero discussion comments; prior acceptance is historical context, not this review's visual proof.

Fresh browser evidence: installed Playwright Chromium, headless, unique `http://127.0.0.1:4377`, Vite mock mode from explicit `frontend` cwd, isolated browser context, fake microphone/device UI and `--mute-audio`. Physical microphone and speakers were not used. Reduced motion was enabled. Native visible UI registration, mock verification code, upload of the repository's synthetic `source-dialogue.mp4`, millisecond selection, quote, processing and microphone permission/check preceded Record. No store seeding or fault injection was used. Same-context second page tested visible recording denial. Browser and this review's Vite child were closed in `finally`.

Capture command, repository cwd: `node _docs/evidence/proactive-visual-qa-2026-10-25/issue-77/capture.cjs`. The disposable script is retained. The initial run assumed EN although the landing default was RU, and a second exploratory run used `Stay` instead of actual `Stay here`; these were capture-script mistakes, not product findings. The final run explicitly selects EN, waits for fonts and settled layout, completes all 17 captures, and contains no page-error log. Earlier transient black-stage/decoder frames were overwritten by the final settled run. No old screenshots are used. Every final screenshot in the manifest was opened using `view_image` and visually inspected.

## Task purpose and expected versus actual

The user's job is to rehearse a fixed supplied line against the scene, record once, review a single unaccepted candidate, accept it safely and navigate without losing protected media. The design should make the next spoken line and the frequent rehearsal controls immediately usable while keeping draft and accepted progress distinct.

| Criterion/state | Expected | Fresh actual / evidence | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-01 entry | No autoplay/capture; separate turn position and accepted progress; disabled own recording with explanation | Line1/3, accepted0/3, stopped0:00, visible disabled My recording and explanation in01/03/04/05 | Confirmed in bounded native journey |
| AC-02 capture | Explicit start, no manual Stop/countdown; video/reference continues; other actions disabled, volume available |09 shows moving synthetic frame relative to01, recording status/progress, disabled transport/actions and enabled volume | Visible behavior confirmed; precise audio mix/timing not proved by stills |
| AC-03 completion | Automatic fixed-window end yields usable unaccepted review; no autoaccept/advance |10 shows candidate, accepted0/3 and stopped playback; later17 shows line2 candidate and still1/3 | Happy path confirmed; interruption/zero-data not rerun |
| AC-04 persistence | Draft recovery and accepted facts stay distinct |10/12 header explicitly says saved draft has not been accepted;0/3 unchanged | Visual distinction confirmed; cross-device/reload durability not rerun |
| AC-05 Next | Candidate accepted before next turn/progress; first accepted take locks reprocessing |13 shows Take accepted, Line2/3, accepted1/3, Process again disabled with lock reason | Bounded success confirmed; stale/timeout/failure not injected |
| AC-06 assembly | Initial final-gap trigger and completed-revision authorization preserve safety/destination | Only first of3 turns accepted | Not exercised; no assembly claim |
| AC-07 guards/access | Back with candidate offers its3 choices; workspace exit its3 choices; losing tab cannot record/accept |11/15 workspace dialog has Save and leave / Leave without saving / Stay here and Stay preserves candidate.16 second page denies capture/acceptance.17 candidate disables Previous line | **Mismatch QA-77-01**; second-page visible denial only, no mutation/security proof |
| AC-08 reprocessing | First acceptance locks; launch/failure preserves preparation |13 lock message confirmed | Launch/failure branches not rerun |
| AC-09 responsive/EN/RU | Readable target, normal desktop controls, pinned phone actions, suitable targets and no overflow |390 EN/RU readable,48px actions;1440×700 desktop panel in flow.767 target partly covered | **Mismatch QA-77-02**; keyboard/SR/real-device clearance not fully proved |
| AC-VIS-01 reference/state | Mapped buttons, segmented tray, statuses/dialog derivatives, Mabry |01–17 show quiet Clean/Light controls and real loaded font check; native default/saving-completed/capture/candidate/accepted/denied/dialog states | Partial reference fidelity; **QA-77-03** questions compact requirement usability; save-error/stale/assembly not covered |

## Findings

### QA-77-01 — MEDIUM — A candidate blocks backward navigation instead of opening its guard

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Evidence status:** confirmed by native journey, DOM and source. **Affected:** AC-07; Flow09 §5.8, including the required Back candidate guard; AC-01 navigation context.

**Reproduce:** complete a recording on line1 and select Next line; on line2 capture a new candidate and wait until the header says Draft saved. Try to go to Previous line. The final screenshot17 is line2, not the first-turn boundary. DOM metrics show `Previous line.disabled: true`, height28px. Before capture on the same line it is enabled in13.

**Expected:** backward navigation remains available outside capture/save, opening exactly Save and go / Go without saving / Stay, then preserving the requested backward destination under the selected branch. **Actual:** Previous line is disabled for every non-null draft, so the user cannot reach that guard. They must accept forward, rerecord or leave the workspace instead. No data-loss claim is made; this is missing required navigation choice and an unnecessary workflow constraint.

**Source:** [RecordingScreen.tsx:1727](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/recording/RecordingScreen.tsx:1727) disables Back with `draft !== null`; the issue's scope explicitly requires the Back three-action guard. Flow09 [line50](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/09-record.md:50) states the owner may move back while a candidate exists.

**Scoped recommendation:** route candidate-bearing Back through the existing guarded transition mechanism and distinguish its Save-and-go/discard copy from workspace leave; retain capture/save/access disabling. **Next validation:** line2 candidate, each of3 Back choices; failure keeps candidate and current turn, successful choices arrive on line1, Stay has no mutation, existing accepted line1 remains protected.

![Line2 saved candidate disables Previous line](evidence/17-en-line2-candidate-back-disabled.png)

### QA-77-02 — MEDIUM — The pinned layout covers the target line at the 767px breakpoint

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect in responsive composition. **Evidence status:** confirmed screenshot plus DOM overlap. **Affected:** AC-09, AC-VIS-01; Flow09 target readability and phone pinned-control clearance.

**Reproduce:** open ready Record, choose RU, set viewport767×900 and scroll to top. **Expected:** the target to perform remains fully readable above the pinned panel, together with the dominant scene. **Actual:** target text occupies y680.44–704.44, while the opaque pinned panel starts y691.00. Approximately13.44px of its24px line box is covered. The video expands to735×413.44 at y225. At390×844 the target is clear; at768×900 desktop controls are in flow and the target is clear. This is a breakpoint/available-height composition issue, not a claim that every phone view fails. A user can scroll, but automatic entry presents a partly hidden core instruction. Capture at767 was not independently rerun, so this report does not claim the occlusion persists through every capture/scroll state.

**Source:** [RecordingScreen.css:327](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/recording/RecordingScreen.css:327) makes the phone stage100% wide; [line616](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/recording/RecordingScreen.css:616) fixes the panel. Bottom padding at613 provides document reachability but does not keep the target visible in the initial viewport. Flow09 [line66](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/09-record.md:66) defines the spoken target as the screen's first question, and its target anatomy requires readable text without control coverage.

**Scoped recommendation:** constrain stage height in the pinned layout using the available height after header, target and actual panel height, while retaining16:9 and media priority.
